welcome.title: What’s new in HocusPocus
welcome.subtitle: Your local AI studio for video, images, audio and 3D. These are the keys to starting a production well.
welcome.modelsBody: The install set up the app, not the model weights. The first time you use a given model, its files download once — often tens of GB for a video model — before anything appears. Later runs are fast. Watch progress at the bottom-right; the very first video can take a while.
welcome.directorTitle: Director runs on a local LLM
welcome.directorBody: Director mode plans your video with a local language model (Gemma 4, ~5 GB, downloaded on first Director use) — nothing is sent to the cloud. You can switch models, or plug in an external API, under Settings → Services.
welcome.recentHint: One short line per PR, newest first. Scroll the list to see them all.
